svg.title: Eventiva layer 4, group 1
svg.desc: Prerequisite arrows point toward dependent issues. Layers are derived, not approved dates. Labels and border patterns distinguish completed, current, upcoming, closed and blocked work. Every node links to its live issue; Markdown provides full titles, prerequisites and unlocks.
svg.text: Derived layers; not deadlines or acceptance.
Blocked overrides fill/border; current keeps double.

a.aria-label: EVE-84: F3.4 Build event-relative due dates, task templates and reschedule cascade. UPCOMING / BLOCKED. Captured Linear: Backlog. 2026-11-17T12:31:56.867Z: later-status: Live description and complete comment list independently reviewed: EVE-84 covers general Event planning, not MDT only. Jonathan's conditional 2026-11-17 decision therefore selects option B: confirm every Event/Phase anchor-date change, including dependency-delay cascades; non-anchor dates may cascade automatically. Exact owner-selection time is unknown; this date is the Amp Linear relay, not the owner-selection or capture time. Baseline/history, absolute/completed-date exclusions, manual locks, authorization and readiness remain. The prior source ambiguity is resolved, but implementation prerequisites and whole-issue acceptance remain open. Frozen capture is unchanged; this is not a complete live roadmap refresh. Sources: https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-84#comment-f9c96ce3-873a-46ba-9702-bf00bcebc44d, https://ampcode.com/threads/T-01a1e940-37a3-7691-a5c0-e935b711c99a. 2 prerequisites; 1 unlocks.
